import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import pytest

# Import the public API from the doorstop package
from doorstop.core.document import Document
from doorstop.core.item import Item
from doorstop.core.tree import Tree
from doorstop.core.vcs.mockvcs import WorkingCopy as MockWorkingCopy


@pytest.fixture
def temp_dir():
    """Create a temporary directory for the test and clean up afterwards."""
    dirpath = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    yield dirpath
    shutil.rmtree(dirpath)


def _create_document(prefix: str, path: str) -> Document:
    """Helper to create a new document in the given path."""
    # Ensure the directory exists
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    # Create a new document
    doc = Document.new(prefix, path)
    # Persist the document to disk
    doc.save()
    return doc


def _add_requirement(doc: Document, uid: str, text: str = "Test requirement") -> Item:
    """Helper to add a requirement item to a document."""
    item = doc.add_item(uid, text=text)
    doc.save()
    return item


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Test cases
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_001_positive(temp_dir):
    """
    Test requirement storage
    """
    # Arrange
    prefix = "REQDOC"
    doc_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, prefix)
    doc = _create_document(prefix, doc_path)

    # Act
    uid = "REQ001"
    item = _add_requirement(doc, uid)

    # Assert
    # The item should be present in the document and persisted on disk
    assert item.uid == uid
    # Reload the document from disk to ensure persistence
    reloaded_doc = Document.load(doc_path)
    assert any(it.uid == uid for it in reloaded_doc)


def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_002_positive(temp_dir):
    """
    Test requirement change management
    """
    # Arrange
    prefix = "REQDOC"
    doc_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, prefix)
    doc = _create_document(prefix, doc_path)
    uid = "REQ001"
    _add_requirement(doc, uid, text="Initial text")

    # Act
    # Update the requirement text
    item = doc.find_item(uid)
    item.text = "Updated text"
    doc.save()

    # Assert
    reloaded_doc = Document.load(doc_path)
    updated_item = reloaded_doc.find_item(uid)
    assert updated_item.text == "Updated text"


def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_003_positive(temp_dir):
    """
    Test requirement change association
    """
    pytest.skip("NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No public API to associate a developer with a change.")


def test_U02_4__xUnit_Test_C__TC_004_positive(temp_dir):
    """
    Test requirement scalability
    """
    # Arrange
    prefix = "BIGDOC"
    doc_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, prefix)
    doc = _create_document(prefix, doc_path)

    # Create a large number of requirements
    num_items = 5000  # a reasonable number for a unit test
    for i in range(num_items):
        uid = f"REQ{i:04d}"
        _add_requirement(doc, uid, text=f"Requirement {i}")

    # Act & Assert
    # Reload the document and ensure all items are present
    reloaded_doc = Document.load(doc_path)
    assert len(reloaded_doc) == num_items
    # Spot‑check a few items
    for i in [0, num_items // 2, num_items - 1]:
        uid = f"REQ{i:04d}"
        assert any(it.uid == uid for it in reloaded_doc)
